info.cls_ename: Department of Environmental Engineering and Science

description.describe_ch: 法規係抽象或概括的文字，具體表現政府政策，並為社會生活之規範。環境保護立法係將環境保護的目標、責任與方法及費用的歸屬作一詳盡的規劃，並予以成文化，使其具有法的拘束力。因此要瞭解環保法規的涵義、精神及為何要作此規定，須對環境保護工作有所認識與瞭解，尤其各項污染防治之策略與措施更是重要。本課程由理論與實務探討環境問題，並藉由立法程序落實環境保護工作，期能訓練學生具有環境法規之專業知識，有助於未來從事環境保護工作，並對準備各項考試有方向可循。
description.describe_eh: The act or regulation is referred to describe the government policies concretely in a form of characters and play a role of social norms. The purpose of formulating environmental acts or regulations are to define the objectives, stakeholders, monitoring, incentives and penalties explicitly and come to be rules that are socially constructed, publicly known, anticipated and accepted. It is important to understand what's the definition and implication of the regulations by knowing the duties of environmental protection especially in the area of pollution abatement strategies and measures. The course plan is to provide professional knowledge of environmental protection regulations by discussing all the concerned issues in both of the theoretical and practical dimension. It will be useful for students to be engaged in the field of environmental protection or to prepare various professional examinations.
